# Kolaboro

> Kolaboro trains local people, guided by an AI copilot, to verify off-plan property for overseas buyers before each payment: land title and permit checks, site visits with GPS-stamped photos timestamped in Bitcoin, computer-vision "plan vs reality" checks and weekly Sentinel-2 satellite watch. Buyers pay; developers never pay. Launching in Bali and recruiting the first local agents; desk research covers 878 off-plan projects in 144 markets and 76 countries (1 Nov 2026), 7,572 developer claims tested, each check rated by source (official register, independent source, developer only, contradicted, not published). An automated second check of 485 claims in 50 random projects found a 2.2% error rate among checkable claims (see /corrections/). Pre-purchase check €490, construction monitoring €99 a month.

## Facts
- Prices (Bali, launch): pre-purchase check EUR 490; construction monitoring EUR 99 per month; buyer's agent 1% of price, minimum EUR 2,000.
- Agents are never paid by developers. Paying for verification never changes a Trust Score.
- Kolaboro does not currently hold client money and does not give legal or financial advice.
